convert_megatron_glm4v_to_hf: convert a Megatron GLM-4V model with tensor parallelism to HuggingFace format using merge_tp_weights
merge_megatron_tensor_parallel_weights: merge tensor parallel weights from Megatron model checkpoints into a single HuggingFace-compatible state dict
save_sharded_hf_model: save a HuggingFace model state dict as sharded safetensors with an index JSON file
convert_qkv_attention_weights: convert interleaved QKV attention weights from Megatron layout to separate Q, K, V projections for HuggingFace
convert_glu_mlp_weights: convert GLU-style MLP weights (gate/up) from Megatron format to HuggingFace gate_up_proj and down_proj
